# konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider (Resource)

AIGatewayIdentityProvider Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider" "my_aigatewayidentityprovider" {
  provider = konnect-beta
  gateway_id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
  key_auth = {
    config       = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
    display_name = "Okta AI SE"
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
    name = "okta-ai-se"
  }
  openid_connect = {
    config       = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
    display_name = "Okta AI SE"
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
    name = "okta-ai-se"
  }
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider.my_konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider
  id = jsonencode({
    gateway_id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
    id         = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider.my_konnect_ai_gateway_identity_provider '{"gateway_id": "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7", "id": "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"}'
```
